hook.name: FairLaunchHook
hook.description: A fair-launch bonding curve hook that bypasses the Uniswap v4 CL AMM via `beforeSwapReturnsDelta`. ETH↔token swaps execute against a custom curve reserve with configurable buy/sell fees and a floor reserve. Liquidity addition is permanently forbidden. Each swap requires `SwapHookData` (trader, recipient, minOut, deadline) in `hookData`; only a designated router address may trigger swaps.
